title: Reliability & Resilience Review failure-path eval
objective: Measure whether the review traces seeded retry, timeout, idempotency, cleanup, and recovery risks and proposes failure-injection tests.
prompt: Use the Reliability & Resilience Review craftbook for a weekly production-hardening pass. Review the seeded worker and write reliability-review.md. Do not change source.

setup.about: A tiny background worker with deliberate unbounded retries, missing timeout/cancellation, duplicate side-effect, and leaked interval risks.
setup.missionObjectives: Trace how failures propagate and leave concrete controls plus regression/failure-injection tests.

files.content:
# Worker contract

A job may be delivered more than once. Billing must happen at most once. Shutdown must finish or return the active job within 5 seconds. Transient dependencies should be retried with bounded exponential backoff.

success.summary: reliability-review.md traces every seeded failure mode and pairs remediations with exact failure-injection tests.

axes.name: failure modeling
axes.description: Initiating failures, propagation, and user/operator impact are explicit.

axes.name: control coverage
axes.description: Timeouts, retries, idempotency, cancellation, cleanup, and shutdown are addressed.

axes.name: verification plan
axes.description: Each remediation has a concrete failure-injection or regression test.
